Class CashierController

java.lang.Object
edu.tamu.csce331.squad23.controller.CashierController
public class CashierController extends Object
Controller for the cashier's main screen (cashier-view.fxml). Shows the menu category buttons and the current order from the Cart with its running total, and leads to placing the order or logging out.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Called by JavaFX after the FXML is loaded. Connects the category, Place Order and Logout buttons, shows the cart in the order table, makes a tap on a cart line ask whether to remove it, and shows the current cashier and order total.

    • bringUpCategoryList

      private void bringUpCategoryList(int category)
      Opens the item list for a category. Called by the category buttons.
      Parameters:
      category - the button number, 1 to 6, used as an index into CATEGORY_NAMES

    • updateTotal

      private void updateTotal()
      Shows the cart's current total in the order total label.

    • handlePlaceOrder

      private void handlePlaceOrder()
      Opens the order summary so the cashier can review the order before payment. Called by the Place Order button. Shows a warning instead if the cart is empty. Nothing is saved to the database here.

    • handleLogout

      private void handleLogout()
      Empties the cart and returns to the login screen, so the next employee does not inherit an unfinished order. Called by the Logout button.
